package: nLab Framework 1.1.1 — Shadow Sage & Generic UI
purpose: Enregistrer un thème reproductible issu du site de référence, enrichir l'icothèque SVG, fournir une toolbar maximale configurable et généraliser les fenêtres flottantes/ancrables.

theme.style: soft shadow + radial gradient + seamless sticky header

design_rules: Theme stores reusable visual grammar, not project identity.
Projects override tokens rather than fork component CSS.
Toolbar begins maximal and is reduced by configuration.
Project-specific toolbar commands use extension slots.
Help and future floating panels specialize floating_window.
All functional controls use indexed monochrome SVG icons.
next_steps: Implement full toolbar action dispatcher from toolbar-full.json.
Connect Shadow Sage preset to the independent demo page.
Add smoke tests for icon availability, toolbar actions and window docking.
Grow the SVG registry as reusable UI needs appear.
